name: 60657 · Chicago, IL
findings: ZIP 60657 (Chicago) has 231 nonprofit organizations. 111 of them (48%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 89 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (17% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 60657 (Chicago) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list civic or political action
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 60657 (Chicago) list civic or political action in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 11% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 9 organizations here; 39% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find ways to take civic or political action now, including outside formal organizations?
